title: Stadsherberg, Batavia
geometryBasis: The cadastral print and two surviving navigation landmarks fix the former east quay. The panorama locates the inn relative to the landing pavilion. The model uses a photo-derived footprint with approximate rear proportions.
sectionBasis: Rijksmuseum period photographs show an eight-column waterfront veranda, balustraded cornice, a sign, tiled hipped roofs and a later shallow awning.
limitations: The cadastral map and photograph alignment locate the former inn to about 30 m. The building is demolished.
The model uses the late 1860s awning. Roof tile color, rear wing size, glazing and service elevations are interpreted from the black-and-white views.
Only the inn is represented. The separate customs and landing facilities are outside its footprint.
